text: İyi Finans, Fenerbahce Tarfin's Turkiye Ligi below-back-number sponsor, operates as the brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş., a savings-finance (tasarruf finansmanı) company; the company's own announcement of its European federation membership identifies it as a brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş. Turkish business press interviews name company chairman Ekrem Yüksel.
short: İyi Finans is the brand of BDDK-licensed Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş.

source.name: FintekWins - Iyi Finans, EFBS'ye uye olan ilk Turk sirket oldu
source.quote: Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş.'nin markası olarak faaliyet gösteren İyi Finans
